title: f32::INFINITY values not sanitized in with_rf_metrics
description: Lines 863-867: NaN values are sanitized to defaults, but f32::INFINITY and f32::NEG_INFINITY are not. While total_cmp handles infinities correctly for ordering, infinite RSSI/SNR values are physically meaningless and could indicate sensor errors. Consider clamping to valid physical ranges (e.g., -150 to 0 dBm for RSSI).
